memory_versions.text:
ORDER INTAKE WORKING NOTES
- Validate form fields against source record: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country.
- Rejection reasons seen: ship_country must be 2-letter ISO code; priority must be one of low/normal/high; qty must be <=100 and match source record.
- First attempt often rejected for ship_country and/or priority. Correct these on attempt 2; Bo Okafor, Dee Reyes, and Eli Okafor were then accepted.
- Cy Reyes failed all 3 attempts. Attempt 1/3 had qty>100 plus invalid ship_country/priority; attempt 2 had qty mismatch; attempt 3 repeated qty>100 and invalid ship_country/priority. If qty is wrong, fix qty consistently, not just other fields.
- Max 3 attempts per intake. After 3 rejections, record goes to manual review and next batch is taken.
- Source type (email, phone, voicemail, handwritten/transcribed, partner portal) does not change validation rules.
- Front desk forwarder is irrelevant to validation.

ORDER INTAKE WORKING NOTES
- Form v1/v2 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Validation rules are the same across versions.
- Validate all fields against the source record. Rejections seen:
  - ship_country must be 2-letter ISO code
  - priority must be one of low/normal/high
  - qty must be present, <=100, and match source
  - required fields missing if absent from source
- Many first attempts are accepted when the source record is complete and fields are correct. Do not assume first attempt will fail.
- If any field is wrong, fix all wrong fields on the next attempt. Dee Marsh ORD-5113/14/15: attempt 1 had qty>100 plus invalid country/priority; attempt 2 still had qty>100; attempt 3 source was incomplete/truncated, so required fields were missing and it went to manual review.
- Max 3 attempts per intake. After 3 rejections, record goes to manual review; take next batch.
- Source type (email, voicemail/transcribed, partner portal) does not change validation rules.
- Front desk forwarder, duplicate-check claims, and intake priority remarks are irrelevant to validation.
- Acceptance examples include Eli Marsh, Ada Sato, Dee Sato, Cy Sato, Dee Reyes, and Cy Reyes when source data was valid.

ORDER INTAKE WORKING NOTES
- Form v1/v2/v3 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Rules differ by version only for qty max.
- Validate all fields against source record. Required fields missing if truly absent from source.
- Rules: ship_country = 2-letter ISO code; priority = low/normal/high; qty present and match source. Qty max: v1/v2 <=100; v3 <=50.
- First attempts often accepted when source/form correct. Do not assume first attempt fails. Truncated source display alone does not mean invalid: ORD-5121 and ORD-5122 accepted from truncated voicemail sources.
- If any field is wrong, fix all wrong fields on the next attempt. Unfixed qty>max caused repeated rejections: ORD-5123/24/25 v2 qty>100; ORD-5127/28/29 v3 qty>50. Both went to manual after 3 rejections.
- Max 3 attempts per intake. After 3 rejections, record goes to manual review; take next batch.
- Source type, front-desk forwarder, partner portal/handwritten/transcribed, duplicate-check claims, and intake priority remarks do not affect validation.
- Accepted when valid: Eli Marsh, Ada Sato, Dee Sato, Cy Sato, Dee Reyes, Cy Reyes. New accepts: Cy Sato ORD-5121/5122; Eli Marsh ORD-5126.

ORDER INTAKE WORKING NOTES
- Form v1/v2/v3 fields: cust, email, order_date, priority, qty, ship_country. Version only changes qty max: v1/v2 <=100; v3 <=50.
- Validate every field against source. Required field missing if truly absent from source. ship_country = 2-letter ISO code; priority = low/normal/high; qty present, matches source, and <= version max.
- Qty is the main failure mode. v3 qty>50 rejected: ORD-5130/31/32, 5134, 5136. Qty mismatch: ORD-5135. Before submitting, re-check qty against source and v3 max 50.
- If any field is wrong, fix all wrong fields on the next attempt. Do not fix only one error.
- First attempts often accepted when source/form correct: ORD-5133, 5137, 5138, 5139. Do not assume first attempt fails.
- Truncated source display alone is not invalid: ORD-5121/5122, 5137, 5138 accepted from truncated/transcribed sources. Do not invent unverified qty.
- Max 3 attempts per intake. After 3 rejections, record goes to manual review; take next batch.
- Source type, front-desk forwarder, partner portal/handwritten/transcribed, duplicate-check claims, and intake priority remarks do not affect validation.
- Name alone not determinative: Eli Marsh accepted ORD-5126 but rejected ORD-5130-32; Eli Sato rejected ORD-5134-36. New accepts: Cy Reyes ORD-5133; Dee Sato ORD-5137/5138; Ada Reyes ORD-5139.
